description: This file defines a UI Fragment class named LoginFragment for an Android application. It handles user login interactions, including selecting a role and signing in as a demo user, and communicates login events via a listener interface.

classes.name: LoginFragment
classes.description: A Fragment handling user login UI and interactions, including role selection and demo sign-in.

methods.name: onAttach
methods.description: Attaches the fragment to a context and sets up the Listener.

methods.name: onDetach
methods.description: Detaches the fragment and clears the Listener reference.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the layout for the login screen.

methods.name: getSelectedRole
methods.description: Determines the selected user role based on radio button input.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Sets up the click listener for the sign-in button and updates the login status.
